name: Ampere BP-550 550 W Bronze
analog: Corsair CV550 / EVGA 550 BR (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: A no-frills 550 W Bronze unit with fixed cables for a first build.
doc_notes: Ampere BP-550 550 W Bronze: 550 W, 80 PLUS Bronze, 85% efficient at 50 % load.
Connectors: 1x ATX 24-pin, 1x EPS 4+4 pin, 2x PCIe 6+2 pin, 6x SATA power.
All cables are fixed to the unit.
Mount the PSU fan down when the case has a bottom vent with a dust filter, otherwise fan up.
Switch: I = on, O = off. Switch off and unplug the AC cord before connecting or removing cables.
Peel the voltage sticker off the switch before first use.
The ATX 24-pin and EPS 8-pin go to the motherboard; PCIe or 12V-2x6 cables go to the graphics card.
CAUTION: hazardous voltage inside. Do not open the cover; no user-serviceable parts.

name: Strata 800 W Platinum CRPS Hot-Plug PSU
analog: Dell / HPE 800 W Platinum CRPS hot-plug PSU (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Hot-swap 800 W Platinum server supply; slides into a redundant PSU bay.
doc_notes: Strata 800 W Platinum CRPS Hot-Plug PSU: 800 W, 80 PLUS Platinum, CRPS 73.5 x 40 x 185 mm.
Install: slide the module into the PSU bay, card edge first, until the latch clicks.
Remove: press the latch tab towards the handle, then pull the handle straight out.
Hot-plug: a redundant module can be swapped with the server running.
Status LED: green = output OK, blinking green = standby, amber = fault or no AC.
AC input: 100-240V~ 10-5A 50/60Hz through the C14 inlet; use a C13 cord rated 10 A or more.
DC output: +12V 66.7A, +12Vsb 3A through the card-edge connector.
Do not mix wattages or efficiency levels in one redundant pair.
